children: Keysight Technologies Inc.
shares are trending Thursday night.
Q4 Revenue and Earnings Beat Analyst Expectations
Shares of the California-based electronic design and test solutions provider rose 0.31% to $282.30 in after-hours trading Thursday, after it reported better-than-expected fourth-quarter results.
Revenue reached $1.99 billion, beating the
. That was up 41% from $1.42 billion a year earlier.
Earnings per share came in at $3.61, topping the expected $3.32 by 8.73%. A year ago, EPS was $1.91. GAAP net income was $486 million, or $2.82 per share.
Record FY26 Results and Strong Cash Flow
In fiscal 2026, revenue rose to $7.16 billion from $5.37 billion a year earlier. EPS also increased to $11.72, compared with $7.16 in fiscal 2025.
Free cash flow was $1.75 billion for the year and $465 million for the quarter. Cash and equivalents totaled $2.92 billion.
Q1 FY27 Guidance in Focus
Keysight expects first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $2.04 billion to $2.06 billion. It expects EPS of $3.63 to $3.69.
The fourth-quarter and fiscal-year results were announced for the period ended Oct. 31.
CEO
Satish Dhanasekaran
said, "Keysight delivered the strongest year in the company’s history."
